aj5551.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.
s: Name as indexed in a chain
as: ثقة حافظ شهير وله أوهام وقيل كان لا يحفظ القرآن من العاشرة
Trustworthy and a renowned master of hadith, though he made some errors. It is said that he did not know the Qurʾān by heart. He is of the tenth class.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
وأخوه عثمان ما علمت إلا خيرا وأثنى عليه، وقال: عثمان رجل سليم.
I have known only good of his brother ʿUthmān. Aḥmad praised him and called him an upright man.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Both men are trustworthy and reliable.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
ابني أبي شيبة: عثمان وعبد الله ثقتين صدوقين ليس فيهما شك.
The two sons of Abū Shaybah, ʿUthmān and ʿAbd Allāh, are trustworthy and truthful, with no doubt about either.
محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير, quoted by al-Mizzī
سبحان الله ومثله يسأل عنه، إنما يسأل هو عنا.
Glory be to God. Is someone like him to be asked about? He is the one who should be asked about us.
His brother ʿUthmān is a trustworthy Kufan.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
هذه أحاديث موضوعة، أو كأنها موضوعة
These hadiths are fabricated or appear fabricated.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
نراه يتوهم هذ الأحاديث، نسأل الله السلامة.
We think he was mistaken about these hadiths. We ask God for safety.
أبو الفتح الأزدي, quoted by al-Mizzī
تفرد به جرير الرازي إن كان عثمان بن أبي شيبة حفظه، فإنه لم يتابع عليه.
Jarīr al-Rāzī transmitted it alone, if ʿUthmān ibn Abī Shaybah remembered it correctly, for no one corroborated it.
إبراهيم بن عبد الله الخصاف, quoted by al-Mizzī
فلما جهزهم بجهازهم جعل السفينة في رحل أخيه.
Al-Khaṣṣāf reports that ʿUthmān read ‘he put the ship in his brother’s bag’ during an exegesis lesson.
الحسن بن الحسن بن الحباب المقرئ, quoted by al-Mizzī
قرأ عليهم في التفسير (ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بأصحاب الفيل) قالها ال م.
Al-Ḥasan reports that he read the opening of ‘Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the elephant?’ as the separate letters alif, lām, mīm.

aj8035.bio: Named in the dataset's chains and matched to entries in the scholars' biographical books. No Taqrīb profile has been matched yet; the verdicts below are quoted from the books cited.

as: ثقة ثبت وقد رمي بالقدر من كبار السابعة
Trustworthy and dependable, though accused of holding the Qadarī view. He was among the senior members of the seventh generation.
شعبة بن الحجاج, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما من الناس أحد أقول إنه طلب الحديث يريد به الله عزوجل إلا هشام صاحب الدستوائي
Among people I would say of no one except Hishām al-Dastawāʾī that he sought hadith for God's sake.
هشام الدستوائي أعلم بحديث قتادة مني، وأكثر مجالسة له مني.
Hishām knew Qatādah’s hadith better than I and attended him more often.
كان هشام الدستوائي أمير المؤمنين في الحديث.
Hishām al-Dastawāʾī was the commander of the faithful in hadith.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
الدستوائي، لا تسأل عنه أحدا، ما أرى الناس يروون عن أحد أثبت منه، مثله عسى، وأما أثبت منه فلا.
Al-Dastawāʾī. There is no need to ask about him. I think people narrate from no one more dependable than him. Perhaps someone is his equal, but no one exceeds him.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
فإذا سمعت عن هشام عن يحيى فلا ترد به بدلا.
When you hear from Hishām from Yaḥyā, seek no replacement for it.
هشام الدستوائي بصري، ثقة، ثبت في الحديث، كان أروى الناس عن ثلاثة: عن قتادة، وحماد بن أبي سليمان، ويحيى بن أبي كثير، كان يقول بالقدر ولم يكن يدعو إليه.
Hishām was a trustworthy Basran and dependable in hadith, the most prolific narrator from Qatādah, Ḥammād ibn Abī Sulaymān and Yaḥyā ibn Abī Kathīr. He held the Qadarī view but did not advocate it.
كان ثقة ثبتا في الحديث، حجة إلا أنه يرى القدر
He was trustworthy, dependable in hadith and an authority, although he held the Qadarī view.
Abū Zurʿah al-Rāzī, quoted by al-Mizzī
هشام أحب إلي لأن الأوزاعي ذهبت كتبه، وأثبت أصحاب قتادة هشام، وسعيد.
I prefer Hishām because al-Awzāʿī’s books were lost. The most dependable students of Qatādah were Hishām and Saʿīd.
كان أيوب يحث على هشام الدستوائي والأخذ عنه.
Ayyūb encouraged learning from Hishām al-Dastawāʾī.
سألت ابن علية عن حفاظ أهل البصرة، فذكر هشاما الدستوائي.
Asked about Basra’s hadith masters, Ibn ʿUlayyah named Hishām al-Dastawāʾī.
وكان ثقة ثبتا في الحديث حجة. إلا أنه يرمي بالقدر.
He was trustworthy and dependable in hadith, an authority, though he was accused of holding the Qadarī view.

t1563.bio: Ibn Ḥajar calls Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl al-ʿAdawī, Abū Naṣr al-Baṣrī, trustworthy and a scholar, of the third generation; Ibn Sīrīn hesitated about him because he entered the ruler's service.
as: توقف فيه بن سيرين لدخوله في عمل السلطان
Ibn Sīrīn hesitated about him because of his entering the service of the ruler.
كان ابن سيرين لا يرضى حميد بن هلال.
Ibn Sīrīn did not approve of Ḥumayd ibn Hilāl.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
Reliable. Al-Nasāʾī agrees with Ibn Maʿīn.
أبو هلال الراسبي, quoted by al-Mizzī
ما كان بالبصرة أعلم من حميد بن هلال، ما أستثني الحسن ولا ابن سيرين غير أن التناوة أضربه
No one in Basra was more knowledgeable than Ḥumayd, including al-Ḥasan and Ibn Sīrīn, but living on his estate disadvantaged him.
له أحاديث كثيرة، وقد حدث عنه الأئمة، وأحاديثه مستقيمة
He had many hadiths, leading authorities transmitted from him, and his reports are sound.
فلعله كان لا يرضاه في معنى آخر ليس الحديث، فأما في الحديث فإنه لا بأس به، وبرواياته.
Perhaps Ibn Sīrīn disapproved of him on grounds unrelated to hadith. As a transmitter, neither he nor his reports give cause for objection.
ما كان بالمصر رجل أعلم من حميد بن هلال. ما استثنى محمدا ولا الحسن. غير أن التناءة أضرت به.
Qatādah says no one in the city was more knowledgeable than Ḥumayd, making no exception for Muḥammad or al-Ḥasan, though living on his estate disadvantaged him.

t6908.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Manṣūr ibn al-Muʿtamir ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Sulamī, Abū ʿAttāb al-Kūfī, as trustworthy and firmly established, not practicing tadlīs, of the generation of al-Aʿmash; he died in 132.
as: Trustworthy, firmly established, and he did not practice tadlīs.
منصور لا يروي إلا عن كل ثقة.
Manṣūr transmits only from trustworthy people.
ما أحد أثبت عن مجاهد وإبراهيم من منصور.
Nobody is more reliable than Manṣūr in transmitting from Mujāhid and Ibrāhīm.
ما خلفت بعدي بالكوفة آمن على الحديث من منصور بن المعتمر.
I left no one more trustworthy with hadith in Kufa than Manṣūr ibn al-Muʿtamir.
ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Mahdī, quoted by al-Mizzī
لم يكن بالكوفة أحفظ من منصور
No one in Kufa had a better memory than Manṣūr.
Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, quoted by al-Mizzī
منصور أثبت من إسماعيل بن أبي خالد.
Manṣūr is more reliable than Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid.
Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn, quoted by al-Mizzī
منصور أثبت من الحكم بن عتيبة , ومنصور بن أثبت الناس
Manṣūr is more reliable than al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah and is among the firmest transmitters.
ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, quoted by al-Mizzī
إذا حدثك عن منصور ثقة فقد ملأت يديك لا تريد غيره
When a trustworthy person transmits to you from Manṣūr, you have all you need.
إبراهيم بن موسى, quoted by al-Mizzī
أثبت أهل الكوفة منصور، ثم مسعر.
Among the Kufans, Manṣūr is the firmest transmitter, followed by Misʿar.
كان فيه تشيع قليل ولم يكن بغال
He had a slight Shīʿī inclination without going to extremes.
وكان ثقة مأمونا كثير الحديث رفيعا عاليا.
He was trustworthy, reliable, prolific in hadith and of high standing.
حماد بن زيد, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
قال أظنه من هذه الخشبية. قال وما أظنه كان يكذب
He said he thought Manṣūr was among the Khashabiyyah and did not think he lied.
Sufyān ibn ʿUyaynah, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
قد كان عمش من البكاء. كانت له خرقة ينشف بها الدموع من عينيه.
His eyes were weakened from weeping. He kept a cloth to dry his tears.
Sufyān al-Thawrī, quoted by Ibn Saʿd
كنت إذا حدثت الأعمش عن بعض أصحاب إبراهيم فإذا قلت منصور سكت.
When I narrated to al-Aʿmash from some of Ibrāhīm’s students, he fell silent when I mentioned Manṣūr.

t7473.bio: Ibn Ḥajar lists Wahb ibn Ḥudhayfa (also called Ḥudhāfa) al-Ghifārī as a Companion, one of the people of the Ṣuffa, who lived until the caliphate of Muʿāwiya.

t7639.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Yaḥyā ibn Muḥammad ibn Qays al-Muḥāribī al-Ḍarīr, Abū Muḥammad al-Madanī, resident of Basra, nicknamed Abū Zukayr, as truthful but making many mistakes, of the eighth generation.

t8151.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Abū Sahla, client of ʿUthmān ibn ʿAffān, as trustworthy and of the third generation.

t8357.bio: Ibn Ḥajar describes Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī or al-Ḥaḍramī, servant of the mosque in Damascus or Ḥimṣ, possibly named ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Māʿiz and possibly a client of Abū Hurayra; trustworthy, of the second generation.

t838.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Thabāt ibn Maymūn as acceptable, of the seventh generation.

t8533.bio: Ibn Ḥajar lists Asmāʾ bint Yazīd al-Qaysiyya al-Baṣriyya as acceptable and belonging to the sixth generation.

t8546.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Banāna, client of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Anṣārī, who also narrated from ʿĀʾisha, as unknown and of the third generation.

t8601.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records a Zaynab, a Companion who appears in the narration without a lineage; it is said she is bint Jaḥsh, and it is said she is the wife of Ibn Masʿūd.

t8708.bio: Ibn Ḥajar records Umm Bilāl bint Hilāl al-Aslamiyyah, trustworthy, of the second generation; it is said she had Companionship.
